about.label: About Us
about.title:
We Build Brighter Futures
With Children & Communities
about.sub: A child-focused charity rooted in partnership.
about.lead: Hope Foundation works alongside children, their families, and local partners to create lasting change in the places where support matters most.
about.mission_title: We create lasting, positive change for and with children
about.mission_p1: Hope Foundation is an independent children's charity dedicated to transforming the lives of children in the world's most vulnerable communities.
about.mission_p2: We work alongside children, their families, and local partners - discovering new solutions to help every child survive, learn, and be protected. What started as a small initiative supporting 50 children in rural Kenya has grown into a network reaching 5,000+ children across 45 communities in 12 countries.
about.mission_highlight: We take a holistic approach: education, nutrition, safe shelter, emergency relief, and community resilience - because a child who is hungry or afraid cannot focus on learning.
about.principles_desc: Four principles guide everything we do - from program design to how we manage every donation.

principles_items.title: Child-Centred
principles_items.desc: Every decision starts with one question - is this best for the child?

principles_items.title: Community-Led
principles_items.desc: We co-design every program alongside local families and leaders.

principles_items.title: Transparent
principles_items.desc: Annual impact reports and independent financial audits - no exceptions.

principles_items.title: Sustainable
principles_items.desc: We build lasting systems so change continues long after we leave.

about.history_desc: Twenty years of growing alongside the children and communities we serve.

history_items.event: Founded with a mission to support 50 children in rural Kenya.
Expanded to 3 countries. Launched our first nutrition program, serving 400 meals a day.
Opened our 10th learning centre. Reached 1,000 children for the first time.
Launched the Emergency Relief Fund. Responded to our first humanitarian crisis.
3,000+ children supported. Operating in 12 countries across 3 continents.
5,000+ children in 45 communities. 85% of every dollar goes directly to programs.
